items.information:
🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2025!** 🟥🟨🟩
Este año celebramos con orgullo el décimo aniversario desde las primeras competencias oficiales en Bolivia, que dieron inicio a nuestra comunidad. Desde entonces, el cubo ha unido a personas de todas las edades y rincones del país, creciendo hasta convertirse en la gran comunidad que tenemos hoy.
La inscripción está abierta para todas las personas, sin importar edad ni lugar de origen. ¡Ven y sé parte de este evento histórico que marcará un antes y un después en Bolivia!


 🟥🟨🟩 **Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2025!** 🟥🟨🟩
This year we proudly celebrate the tenth anniversary since the first official competitions in Bolivia, which marked the beginning of our community. Since then, the cube has united people of all ages and from every corner of the country, growing into the great community we have today.
Registration is open to everyone, regardless of age or origin. Be part of this historic event that will mark a before and after in Bolivia!

items.information:
**ESPAÑOL**
Ver la seccion de indicaciones de registro en la pestaña principal para obtener información detallada.

Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)

Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo.
[Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY)
[Tutorial para competidores nuevos - Jael Riggenbach](https://www.facebook.com/100000565031843/videos/3156907307906324/)

Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID.
•
**ENGLISH**
See the registration requirements on the main tab for detailed information.
•
Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)
•
We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted.
[WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)
•
It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.name: Frost-Free Favorites AZ 2025
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67008-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

### Please note that this is a "Favorites" style competition
Since this is a "Favorites" competition, you may choose at most **five (5) events**.  If you are unfamiliar with this style of a competition, please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67007-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab.  Due to the style of this competition, the schedule may change after registration has closed to allot the appropriate amount of time to each event based on registration numbers.  Due to scheduling so many events, we have a few events that overlap.  You can still register to compete in both events;  you will just do one event's solves and upon finishing, compete in the other event.  

### Please note that competitors are limited to 1 guest each.  This is due to venue space and limited seating available.

### Connect with the Arizona cubing community!
Instagram: [@arizonacubing](https://www.instagram.com/arizonacubing/)
Facebook Group: [Arizona Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/arizonacubing)
